items.title: Law of Conservation of Momentum (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Law of Conservation of Momentum: a main subheading of 2.7 Momentum, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 38-41.

blocks.text: Isolated system (alag thalag system) woh system hai jis par bahar se koi force na lage. Example: constant temperature par sheeshe ke bartan mein band gas ke molecules. Molecules apni random (be-tarteeb) motion ki wajah se aapas mein takrate hain, lekin bartan mein band hone ki wajah se koi bahar ki cheez un par force nahi laga sakti.

blocks.text: Ab do smooth (chikni), hard (sakht) balls ka isolated system lein jin ke mass m₁ aur m₂ hain. Dono ek hi straight line mein ek hi direction mein v₁ aur v₂ velocities se chal rahi hain. Woh takrati hain; collision ke baad m₁ velocity v₁′ se aur m₂ velocity v₂′ se usi direction mein chalti hain (Fig. 2.9).

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Chalti car achanak ruke to passengers (musafir) windshield ki taraf aage jhuk jate hain. Seatbelt motion ki forces ko badal kar musafiron ko aage jane se rokti hai, is liye chot ka khatra bohat kam ho jata hai.
Action force F⃗ aur reaction force F⃗′ barabar aur ulti hain (Newton ka third law): F⃗′ = -F⃗, yani F⃗ + F⃗′ = 0. Is liye equation ka left side zero hai:
Yani pehli ball ka change in momentum + doosri ball ka change in momentum = 0.
Matlab: collision se pehle system ka total momentum collision ke baad ke total momentum ke barabar hai. Is liye do balls wale isolated system ke total momentum mein koi change nahi hota.

Aise kisi bhi group mein, agar ek cheez par force lage to usi group ki kisi doosri cheez par barabar aur ulti reaction force zaroor hogi. Result: poore group ka total momentum kabhi nahi badalta. Yahi law of conservation of momentum hai:
Isolated system ka total linear momentum constant rehta hai.
Yeh law lagate waqt yaad rakhein ke momentum vector hai, is liye direction ka sign (+ ya -) zaroor lagayein.

blocks.title: Example 2.7
blocks.problem: 2.0 kg aur 3.0 kg ki do spherical (gol) balls ek doosre ki taraf 6.0 m s⁻¹ aur 4 m s⁻¹ ki velocities se aa rahi hain. Collision ke baad bari ball ki velocity 3.0 m s⁻¹ ho to chhoti ball ki velocity kya hogi?
steps: Balls aamne saamne aa rahi hain, is liye un ki velocities ke sign ulte hain. 2 kg ball ki direction positive aur 3 kg ball ki negative lein.
Collision se pehle momentum: m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = 2 kg × 6 m s⁻¹ + 3 kg × (-4 m s⁻¹) = 12 kg m s⁻¹ - 12 kg m s⁻¹ = 0
Collision ke baad momentum: m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′ = 2 kg × v₁′ + 3 kg × (-3 m s⁻¹)
Conservation se: pehle ka momentum = baad ka momentum, yani 0 = 2 kg × v₁′ - 9 kg m s⁻¹
blocks.answer: v₁′ = 4.5 m s⁻¹ (positive; kitab bari ball ki baad wali velocity -3 m s⁻¹ leti hai, yani bari ball apni pehli direction mein hi chalti rehti hai, aur chhoti ball bhi apni pehli direction (positive) mein 4.5 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai)

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Motorcycle ke safety helmet mein padding (gaddi) is liye hoti hai ke collision ka time lamba ho jaye aur sakht chot na lage.

blocks.prompt: 20 g ki gend squash court ki deewar se 0.50 s tak 50 N ki constant force se takrati hai; impulse nikalein. Ek footballer 0.25 s tak 240 N ki average force lagata hai; change in momentum aur us ki direction batayein. Seatbelt aur helmet chot kyun kam karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Impulse = F × t = 50 N × 0.50 s = 25 N s (mass ki zaroorat nahi). Change in momentum = 240 N × 0.25 s = 60 N s = 60 kg m s⁻¹, us direction mein jis taraf force lagi (jahan kick maari). Helmet ki padding aur seatbelt momentum badalne ka time lamba kar dete hain; momentum ke utne hi change ke liye average force F = (mvf - mvi)/t kam ho jati hai.

items: p⃗ = mv⃗ (kg m s⁻¹ = N s), vector. F⃗ × t = mv⃗f - mv⃗i: force = momentum badalne ka rate (yeh form badalte mass par bhi lagti hai). Impulse = F × t = change in momentum (Example 2.6: -2.5 kN).
Conservation: isolated system mein F⃗′ = -F⃗, is liye m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = m₁v₁′ + m₂v₂′; total linear momentum constant rehta hai (sign ka khayal rakhein). Example 2.7: v₁′ = 4.5 m s⁻¹.
